verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.crossmint.com returns HTTP 200 with a product summary. Crossmint also has a dedicated AI-assistants docs page for ingesting the docs into tools like Cursor and Copilot, including a server that returns only the most relevant sections for a query. The doc pages themselves are published as .md files, which agents can read directly. Missing for 10: details of that doc-query server (protocol, setup) and any evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
